doc.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08

title: Jelly Roll's recording sessions and later meetings in New York
summary: Zutty describes how the sessions felt, the old jazz feeling, how easy Jelly made it on drums, and seeing him afterwards on Broadway. He recorded with him but never played a regular job.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography
